question: V100-SXM2 (Compute Capability 7.0) 不支持 FP8 或 FP4 原生硬件指令，NVFP4 量化在 V100 上必须反量化为 FP16/BF16 或 INT8 进行计算，导致 'Dequantization Overhead' 抵消部分带宽优势，实测推理延迟相比纯 FP16 仅优化 10-20%，而非预期的 4x 加速。

sources.title: [启动器] 这张显卡不受支持 · Issue #845 · FlashML-org/FreeVideo
sources.snippet: Environment: FreeVideo 0.5.4 [CUDA_ARCH_UNSUPPORTED] Tesla V100-SXM2-16GB (SM70; compute capability 7.0; driver 581.80). FreeVideo requires native BF16 GPU computation (compute capability 8.0 / SM80 or newer). This GPU is below that hardware requirement; a driver update cannot add it.
